svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four, all the same. Bar 70 x 28, 315 long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centres 245 apart on the bar's centre line, 35 from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round both ends to a 35 radius about the centres.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 41 at both centres for the pressed-in bushes (35 bore),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bores parallel within 0.2 mm over the 28 mm thickness.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill all four links clamped together, or on a jig, so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press in the bushes with a vice or press; ream to fit the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 35 pins with a light running fit; add a grease nipple at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one end of each link (6 mm hole into the bore).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two lower links outside (64 to 92 from the centre line),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two upper links inside (32 to 60), with spacers between.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: all four links stacked, a 35 pin passes through both ends.
